hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f CLAUDE.md ]; then LAST=$(git log -1 --format="%H" -- CLAUDE.md README.md 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$LAST" ]; then COUNT=$(git rev-list --count "$LAST"..HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then echo "[docs] $COUNT commit(s) since docs were last updated. Run /update-docs after committing current work."; fi; fi; fi'
